status: PROVED H5 MULTI-OBSTRUCTION GATE: FINITE TRADES FORCE FOUR LOW COEFFICIENTS TO VANISH
theorem: For a 10-support R in mu_n, the monic degree-five square root candidate for L_R+lambda is forced by the coefficients of degrees 10 through 5.  A finite h=5 trade can occur only if the four low coefficients X^1..X^4 of S_R^2-L_R vanish modulo the row prime and the constant discrepancy is a nonzero square.  Since X24 forbids characteristic-zero h=5 trades, every characteristic-p h=5 trade is p-specific: after clearing powers of two, p divides the cyclotomic norm of each nonzero obstruction.
